bullets: Measure accuracy, macro F1, reconstruction, time and storage.

title: Theory: SVD and Kernel SVM
bullets: A = UΣVᵀ; use training-fitted Vᵣ for every unseen trial.
z = aVᵣ; reconstruction = aVᵣVᵣᵀ.
Centered rank ≤ min(Ntrain − 1, 128).
K(z,z′) = exp(−γ‖z−z′‖²).
C penalizes margin violations; γ controls locality.
notes: Explain variance versus discrimination, then margin, support vectors and the RBF kernel. Derivations are in backups.

title: Proposed methodology
bullets: EDF → audit → independent filtering → epochs
